A brief moment during the APEC summit in Shenzhen, China, has caught attention after US President Donald Trump was seen with his eyes closed while Chinese President Xi Jinping delivered his address. Footage from the 33rd APEC Economic Leaders' Meeting shows Trump appearing to rest his eyes during the plenary session as Xi addressed leaders from 21 APEC member economies. Was the US President dozing off after a hectic week of diplomatic engagements? The brief camera moment has sparked curiosity.
Produced & Edited By Ankit Kumar
